content.text: In regions like Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela, traditional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal are often inaccessible, leaving digital creators without a viable way to sell their products. This guide addresses how to leverage [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-which-architecture-actually-21|COREMERCH guide to sovereign]]-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-explained-digital-creators-3|Sovereign Commerce]] digital commerce stacks to sell your ebooks, courses, and templates directly to your audience using [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-how-one-creator|crypto]] payments, without the burden of high platform fees. With NOWPayments charging just 0.5%, you retain significantly more revenue compared to platforms that take a cut of every sale. Let's explore how to set up your infrastructure for success.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators-6. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

The failure of traditional payment systems is a reality for many digital creators. By adopting a sovereign commerce infrastructure, you eliminate reliance on platforms that impose restrictions and high fees. Instead of losing up to 10% of your sales to services like Gumroad, you can keep more money in your pocket with systems designed for creators in regions underserved by conventional payment providers. This approach not only gives you control over your finances but also retains ownership of your data and products, ensuring you are not at the mercy of fluctuating platform policies.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To get started, you need a few essential tools. First, set up a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, both of which are free. Then, choose a backend solution such as Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for processing logic. For storage, opt for Supabase or Google Sheets to manage your orders. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for crypto transaction processing. All these tools are accessible, allowing you to build a robust digital storefront without incurring upfront costs. With your infrastructure in place, you are ready to create a seamless shopping experience for your customers.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Your payment and delivery pipeline is crucial for ensuring customers receive their products instantly after purchase. Start by configuring NOWPayments to handle transactions in various cryptocurrencies, converting prices to USD at the moment of payment. Next, use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for hosting your digital products. By utilizing Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, automate the delivery process so that once payment is confirmed, customers receive their download links immediately. This streamlined approach enhances customer satisfaction and can drive repeat sales, as buyers appreciate swift service and transparency.
Keep 99.5% of your revenue by avoiding high platform fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your setup is complete, it's time to go live. Ensure your GitHub or Cloudflare Pages site is running smoothly. Test the entire transaction process to confirm that payments are being processed via NOWPayments and that product delivery is functioning correctly. Start by promoting your products through social media channels or digital marketing strategies suited to your audience. Monitor your first transaction closely to troubleshoot any issues that may arise. This is your opportunity to refine the customer experience and make necessary adjustments before scaling your operations.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing initial transactions, consider scaling your operations. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all six blueprints and seven templates needed for expansion. This comprehensive resource equips you with the tools to manage increased sales, diversify your product offerings, and streamline operations even further. As you grow, continuously analyze customer feedback and sales data to identify areas for improvement. Implementing additional marketing strategies or expanding your product range will enhance your online store's performance and profitability.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can leverage a sovereign digital commerce stack. By using tools like GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for processing crypto payments, you eliminate the need for traditional payment platforms while keeping fees low. This means you retain more revenue from each sale.
Automate delivery to enhance customer satisfaction and drive repeat sales.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit provides everything you need to create a sovereign digital commerce stack, ensuring you can sell your ebooks, templates, and more while retaining full control over your sales. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore your options.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Use a sovereign digital commerce stack that includes hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend logic with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This setup allows you to sell directly to customers without relying on traditional payment platforms.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best way is to use tools that charge minimal fees, like NOWPayments, which takes only 0.5%. This approach, combined with self-hosted solutions, eliminates high platform fees and ensures you keep more of your revenue.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts using your sovereign digital commerce stack. By setting up your infrastructure with free hosting and a crypto payment processor, you maintain control and avoid the fees associated with platforms like Gumroad or Payhip.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my digital products?

With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies. This flexibility allows you to cater to a diverse customer base and ensures you can process transactions efficiently, regardless of your location.
How do I handle product delivery after a sale?

Automate your product delivery using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to host files, coupled with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to send download links to customers immediately upon payment confirmation.
Own your infrastructure to ensure complete control over your digital commerce.
